templates.label: 手遊日系 RPG 角色卡
templates.description: 適合抽卡角色、立繪與角色檔案頁；以清晰輪廓和易讀表情為優先。
templates.prompt: anime game character, full body character sheet, dynamic heroic pose, clean silhouette, vibrant cel shading, gacha game illustration

templates.label: 休閒手遊 3D 道具／角色
templates.description: 適合農場、料理與生活模擬遊戲；強調明亮、圓潤且在小螢幕可辨識。
templates.prompt: cute casual mobile game asset, rounded shapes, friendly proportions, pastel colors, polished 3d render, readable icon silhouette
templates.negative: dark horror, realistic grime, tiny unreadable details

templates.label: 策略卡牌奇幻角色
templates.description: 適合卡牌框、英雄半身像與技能演出；以戲劇光影與清楚焦點為主。
templates.prompt: fantasy card game hero, dramatic rim light, ornate costume, readable portrait composition, premium collectible card illustration
templates.negative: flat lighting, cropped face, text, watermark

templates.label: Steam 黑暗奇幻概念圖
templates.description: 適合 Steam RPG 的角色、敵人與場景概念；優先呈現材質、尺度與氛圍。
templates.prompt: dark fantasy AAA game concept art, cinematic lighting, weathered materials, intricate armor, atmospheric depth, Unreal Engine render
templates.negative: cute chibi, flat vector, oversaturated colors

templates.label: Steam 溫馨模擬場景
templates.description: 適合療癒、農場與建造類遊戲；以溫暖光線和可探索的場景層次為主。
templates.prompt: cozy indie game environment, storybook illustration, warm golden hour, inviting composition, handcrafted details, soft painterly texture

templates.label: 科幻動作武器／介面素材
templates.description: 適合武器、載具、HUD 和宣傳圖；保留明確輪廓與高科技材質對比。
templates.prompt: sci-fi action game asset, hard surface design, emissive cyan accents, tactical silhouette, premium 3d game render, high contrast

templates.label: 獨立 Roguelike 像素素材
templates.description: 適合角色、道具與小型場景設計；強調有限色盤和明確可讀性。
templates.prompt: pixel art roguelike game asset, limited color palette, crisp pixel clusters, readable silhouette, retro game sprite design
